It has multiple retail businesses closely tied to daily life, namely food, automobiles and meat, with a store network of 223 Gyomu Super stores, 71 Autobacs stores and 191 Oniku no Terabayashi stores (as of March 31, 2026).
entries.d67911c82e075e6c: As its basic management philosophy, it sets out “social contribution,” “self-realization” and “fulfillment of aspirations,” and aims to realize seven items, including expansion of business scope in response to diversifying needs, development of new businesses, contribution to local communities by offering commercial food ingredients at low prices, and business operations that emphasize cash flow. In practice, it is founded on respect for people and upholds customer-first and on-the-spot principles. It takes on process innovation and productivity improvement through DX promotion as new management themes, aiming to expand its earnings capability.
